#LYICMGat50 50 recordings, ahead of my 50th birthday. At #19 we have Shostakovich’s Piano Quintet with Elisabeth Leonskaja and the Borodins. Stupendous music-making with an amazing balance between bleakness and beauty. https://t.co/6L8urK26gc

#LYICMGat50 50 recordings, ahead of my 50th birthday. At #17 we have Eugen Jochum’s truly inspired Schubert Unfinished from Boston. A darkly dramatic first movement is followed by flowing lyrical elegance in the second. https://t.co/SLsH3eHNhP

#LYICMGat50 50 recordings, ahead of my 50th birthday. At #11 we have another Piano disc, this time with Pollini. I believe this was his Debut for DG. The Stravinsky and Prokofiev are thrilling and deserve the widest possible attention. https://t.co/vb8UGUAzD7

#LYICMGat50 50 recordings, ahead of my 50th birthday. At #9 we have the complete Holmboe Symphonic Metamorphoses. This is music of genuine depth, but if you want a slightly lighter starting point, try Symphonies 1 and 3! https://t.co/n2YceXYNby

#LYICMGat50 50 recordings, ahead of my 50th birthday. At #8 it’s Leif Segerstam and Sibelius. The Lemminkäinen Legends are thrilling here, but there’s also a terrifying Tapiola. As a whole, the disc is irresistible. https://t.co/eP0OHKuJdI

#LYICMGat50 50 recordings, ahead of my 50th birthday. And it’s now the top 5. At #5 we have Charles Munch’s spellbinding Martinů Fantaisies Symphonies. This performance is simply astonishing, both for execution but also for the interpretive majesty. Quite a record. https://t.co/StS4c5rM2E

#LYICMGat50 50 recordings, ahead of my 50th birthday. And it’s now the top 5. At #4 it’s Bernard Haitink’s stunning Debussy collection. I particularly love La Mer here, but it’s all great. I might choose others for individual works, but I treasure everything here. https://t.co/NCcwNyS0rt

#LYICMGat50 50 recordings, ahead of my 50th birthday. And it’s now the top 5. At #3 it is Klemperer’s Mahler Das Lied Von der Erde, with Wunderlich and Ludwig. Such deeply moving music making is the stuff of legend. https://t.co/3HTV2VHYTp

#LYICMGat50 50 recordings, ahead of my 50th birthday. And it’s now the top 5. At #2 we have a set that was conceived as a single whole. The Bis Sibelius Edition contains multiple gems and I cannot imagine living without it. https://t.co/MQceasEGRR
